description: Reverse Anything: reverse engineer one of your own videos. It finds every shot with its cut times, the words on screen and the music speed, and saves a storyboard and a picture of each shot into a new folder in your Switch library. With report_id (a finished Video Analysis report of the same video) the answer also carries that report, its recreation prompt and the reference pictures the prompt asks you to supply. Free. It answers at once with a task_id; the result is read with get_task_status a few minutes later. This is taking a video apart, not playing it backwards.

name.description: Optional. A short name for the folder the pieces are saved in.

report_id.description: Optional. A finished Video Analysis report of the same video, from analyze_video_report or list_vision_reports.

video_id.description: One of your own video ids, from list_my_videos or list_my_assets. For a file of yours, upload it first with upload_media and pass the id it gives.

name: reverse_video
title: Reverse Video
